protocol.decision_rule: Argmax of arithmetic mean probability vector; no calibration or weight fitting
protocol.selection: Choose pair maximizing equal-task mean one-versus-rest AUC on saved final-checkpoint validation predictions for motion and contour only; ties choose MobileNet-SE pair
protocol.test_use: Load test predictions only after saving validation selection. Test was already inspected in the original comparison, so this is posthoc reused-test exploratory analysis, not fresh confirmation. Report both predefined pairs transparently.
protocol.comparison: Paired correct/wrong contingency; BA and AUC of constituents and mean-probability ensemble; differences against each constituent and descriptive best heldout constituent; oracle any-constituent-correct accuracy is unattainable label-informed upper bound
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 paired generated-pair bootstrap samples per task, fixed seed 202609129; same resampled indices for all compared predictions. Conditional on saved trained models, no training-seed replication or post-selection coverage guarantee
protocol.resources: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1, numerical-library threads1; saved JSONL only; no torch/model/inference/training
